question: What protection is requested from the all-seeing giver of universal bliss?
premises: He is bowed to by Hari and Hara and is the eye of the universe.
A request is made for him to protect the speaker.
inference: The all-seeing, bliss-giving deity revered by Hari and Hara is asked to protect the speaker.
plain_english: May the giver of all bliss, bowed to by Hari and Hara, the eye of the universe, protect me.
